{1: 'Sefirah Engine', 2: 'Atlantic Eye'}
{2: 'Sefirah Engine, Atlantic Eye'}
{3: 'The woman in black armor flicks her wrist with a dismissive snort, completely ignoring you and turning her full attention to her former student.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'You really think this is the time or place for a chat?', 4: '1', 18: '100021217'}

{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'What are you hoping for here? That I'd throw down my weapons, take a seat, and walk you through how I died? A little trip down memory lane, maybe some heartfelt confessions? Then we cry our eyes out and move on?', 4: '1', 18: '100021218'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'Save the theatrics.', 4: '1', 18: '100021219'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'I've always separated business and personal matters. What you're holding is my objective. Hand it over, or I'll take it myself. Your call.', 4: '1', 18: '100021220'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'You don't get to give me ultimatums, Rusalka. And there's no moving on from this.', 4: '1', 18: '100021221'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHuaping.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong01.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{3: 'Waves surge through Adelyde's M.I.N.D., and fragmented memories begin to surface.'}
{2: '(Increase Mind Beacon power)', 3: '26'}
{2: '(Adelyde, observe calmly.)', 3: '28', 4: '(Do you remember the anomaly you learned from Alyssa all those years ago?)', 5: '26'}
{3: 'Adelyde clenches her fist, forcing her M.I.N.D. to hold onto your Mind Beacon as she combs through a lifetime of memories with a clear head.'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong01.prefab'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHuaping.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory211.png'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Rusalka? The Day of Enlightenment celebration?', 4: '1', 18: '100021222'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'My teacher never celebrated the Day of Enlightenment. Who really gave you this order—', 4: '1', 18: '100021223'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1637.jpg'}
{3: 'Adelyde gives you a silent thumbs-up behind her back, her eyes never leaving Rusalka.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Your objective is in my hands, and I could consume this half of the Sefirah at any moment, so I'm the one calling the shots here. I decide whether we fight.', 4: '1', 18: '100021224'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Threat assessment is based on capability, not intent.', 4: '1', 18: '100021234'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'Heh, sharp tongue. Looks like we'll have to actually talk through this.', 4: '1', 18: '100021236'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'When exactly did you start working for Arius, and why are you still doing so?', 4: '1', 18: '100021238'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Was it when the Atlantic Calamity lured me back, or when the TEC tried to meddle in F.O.S. affairs? Or was it even earlier, on the night before the Erhorn family executed their purge?', 4: '1', 18: '100021239'}
{3: 'Rusalka's blade stops mid-spin. She crosses her arms, her eyebrows raised at Adelyde in disbelief.'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'I'll answer both your questions at once: never, or always.', 4: '1', 18: '100021241'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'I've never worked for him, because the only thing I've ever been loyal to is my own hunger for power.', 4: '1', 18: '100021242'}

{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'I've always worked for him, because in this world of hypocrites, that self-proclaimed superman is the one who actually admits and makes the most of this hunger.', 4: '1', 18: '100021243'}
{3: 'Rusalka looks up at the dome and begins to walk, her footsteps striking the hollow heart of the Atlantic Eye as if beating in its place.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'What do you see every time you look at the Atlantic Eye?', 4: '1', 18: '100021244'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'They said the sun over the Atlantic never sets. We were arrogant, romantic, tireless... we were convinced that we could stand shoulder to shoulder with gods with the Atlantic Eye.', 4: '1', 18: '100021247'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'They weren't wrong. They've just forgotten.', 4: '1', 18: '100021248'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'Look at what's beneath your feet. Look at yourself. What built all of this? It's the hunger for power.', 4: '1', 18: '100021249'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'It is this hunger that drives life to create, to trade, to profit, to improve.', 4: '1', 18: '100021250'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'It is this hunger that pumps through the veins of civilization. Neither praise nor condemnation can diminish it. Once awoken, it never sleeps again.', 4: '1', 18: '100021251'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'What's beneath my feet are the ruins of civilization drowning in blood.', 4: '1', 18: '100021252'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'And it will be more alive than ever before once the Sefirah in your hands resurrects it... just as it resurrected me.', 4: '1', 18: '100021253'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory843.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.2'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory843.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.2'}
{3: 'She opens her arms toward Adelyde, sounding more and more dangerous as an unfamiliar red light spreads from the edges of her pupils.'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'To bury and waste such power is the gravest desecration we can commit against ourselves.', 4: '1', 18: '100021254'}

{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'There's no need for meaningless conflict between us anymore. Let's drag those dead-weight leaders in the seas and in space out of their seats. We'll wield their power properly and devour the next fruit of the Phylotree.', 4: '1', 18: '100021255'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'Come now, my child. Hand—it—over.', 4: '1', 18: '100021256'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Adelyde's frame shudders as if she has been shocked by a current.', 17: '1'}
{3: 'Realization dawns on her face, and she slams her fist into the cannon at her side.', 22: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg1601_7.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius', 3: 'Its fate belongs to me alone, and I will not have it desecrated.', 4: '1', 18: '100021257'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1637.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Resurrection... desecration...', 4: '1', 18: '100021258'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'You don't sound like Rusalka. You sound like... Arius!', 4: '1', 18: '100021259'}
{2: '(Was she brainwashed or manipulated? Or is she being controlled directly?)', 3: '136', 4: '(Knew that dangerous, pompous rhetoric sounded familiar.)'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The sharp talons of Rusalka's dark frame trace across her own face. She stares at her reflection in the metal surface, murmuring to herself.'}

{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'Perhaps when that half of "Understanding" fished me out of the Consciousness Tide, it left out a piece of me... and filled the gap with shards of Arius himself.', 4: '1', 18: '100021260'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'Now I can no longer tell where the gap ends and the shards begin. But...', 4: '1', 18: '100021261'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'I've never felt... so whole. So at peace.', 4: '1', 18: '100021262'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory913.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}

{3: 'Within the M.I.N.D., Adelyde and your voyages trace parallel paths, each weathering different reefs and rapids. Your ships were capsized and rebuilt from scratch multiple times, yet somehow they sail on through it all.'}
{3: 'The same realization echoes in both your hearts.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1637.jpg'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'It's because we're not whole, and we're not at peace...', 4: '1', 18: '100021264'}
{2: '...That's what makes us human.', 3: '160'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1629.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Rusalka', 3: '...There are many kinds of strength. You showed me the rarest one of them all today.', 4: '1', 18: '100021265'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6801_6.jpg'}
{2: 'Rusalka', 3: 'Remember this, Adelyde: your will is the ultimate killer.', 4: '1', 18: '100021266'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1637.jpg'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Rusalka has spent her whole life chasing power, yet like a stone left unpolished in a palace of gold, she has always held fast to her reverence for the strength of will.', 4: '1', 18: '100021267'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'That's why she didn't interfere with my matches later on. That's why she took on a stubborn little kid like me as her student in the first place.', 4: '1', 18: '100021268'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: '...I've known for a long time... The person who once believed in me then cast me aside is never coming back.', 4: '1', 18: '100021269'}
{3: 'Her cannon roars like its wielder's soul, its charged chamber red as blood.'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'But as long as a shred of you still remains in the depths of your soul, I won't let you fall.', 4: '1', 18: '100021270'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Arius, Rusalka... whoever's in there, open your eyes—', 4: '1', 18: '100021271'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'And witness humanity's will!', 4: '1', 18: '100021272'}
